modules.name: 808 Kick
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 bass drum (pulse shaper, bridged-T, feedback decay, attack jump, pitch sigh) with its inner parts on the panel, extended ranges, sustain and AGE

modules.name: 808 Snare
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 snare: two tuned bridged-T heads plus filtered noise (SNAPPY), with TONE (shell balance), RATIO, HISS, SWEEP, SNAP DECAY, COLOUR and AGE

modules.name: 808 Clap
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 hand clap: band-passed noise with a burst sawtooth and reverb tail; BURSTS 1-8, SPREAD, SNAP, TAIL, BAND and AGE

modules.name: 808 Tom / Conga
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 toms and congas: bridged-T with pitch bend and pink-noise slap, LOW/MID/HIGH and TOM/CONGA, with BEND, MUTE, DOUBLE and AGE

modules.name: 808 Rim
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 rim shot: two high resonators through a fast transistor VCA and high-pass; RATIO, RING, GATE, SNAP and AGE

modules.name: 808 Clave
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 claves: a high bridged-T with RING, STRIKE, BEND, OVERTONE and AGE, from click to tuned wood

modules.name: 808 Maracas
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 maracas: high-passed noise through a short VCA, with LENGTH, CUT, GRAINS, SHAKE, ATTACK and AGE

modules.name: 808 Cowbell
modules.description: Circuit model of the TR-808 cowbell: two squares (540/800 Hz) through a band-pass and a two-stage VCA, with INTERVAL, WIDTH, FILTER, SHAPE and AGE

modules.name: 808 Circuit Bench
modules.description: All thirteen TR-808 voices in one 36 HP kit: 16 knobs take every part of the selected voice (named and valued live, grouped by circuit stage), four kit memories with 10 factory kits, double-click a knob for the loaded kit value then stock, RAND near the kit or SHIFT + RAND anywhere (with trigger input), a trigger and output per voice, poly trigger and accent inputs, stereo mix.
